interoperability_envelope.name: Modular Translation Backend — Interoperability Envelope v0

canonical_serialization: deterministic UTF-8 JSON/JSONL with LF line endings
stable_id_rule: Use explicit locale-neutral program/course/resource/edition prefixes plus immutable upstream UUID/content-id/xml-id where present; never derive identity only from translated titles or pages.

progressive_coverage.whole_work: authority, module order, assets, component rights, and cross-document dependencies
progressive_coverage.semantic_units_and_segments: expanded contiguously with translation; first boundary contains m50919, m49299, and m49301
progressive_coverage.completion_rule: all 87 modules must have full semantic-unit and segment coverage before the backend may be called corpus-complete

round_trip_gate: Every JSONL entity set must parse, preserve record order or explicit order fields, project to CSV deterministically, and regenerate byte-identical canonical JSONL from the projection where the projection is lossless.
